characterize_sex <- function(df) {
    sex_df <- data.frame(table(df$"sex")) |>
        dplyr::mutate(
            Var1 = c("F", "M"),
            Freq = paste0(Freq, " (", signif(100 * Freq / nrow(df), 3), "%)")
        ) |>
        dplyr::rename("label" = "Var1", "value" = "Freq")
    sex_df <- rbind(data.frame("label" = "*Sex*", value = ""), sex_df)
    return(sex_df)
}

characterize_age <- function(df) {
    if ("interview_age" %in% colnames(df)) {
        age <- df$"interview_age"
    } else {
        age <- df$"age"
    }
    age_df <- data.frame(
        label = c("*Age*", "Mean (SD)"),
        value = c(
            "",
            paste0(signif(mean(age), 3), " (", signif(sd(age), 2), ")")
        )
    )
    return(age_df)
}

characterize_mtbi_count <- function(df) {
    count <- df$"mtbi_count"
    mtbi_count_df <- data.frame(
        label = c(
            "Prior concussions",
            "Mean (SD)",
            "Range"
        ),
        value = c(
            "",
            paste0(signif(mean(count), 3), " (", signif(sd(count), 2), ")"),
            paste0(min(count), " - ", max(count))
        )
    )
    return(mtbi_count_df)
}

sample_characterize <- function(df) {
    sex_df   <- characterize_sex(df)
    age_df   <- characterize_age(df)
    count_df <- characterize_mtbi_count(df)
    income_df <- data.frame(table(df$"household_income")) |>
        dplyr::mutate(
            Var1 = dplyr::case_when(
                Var1 == 1 ~ "<$50,000",
                Var1 == 2 ~ "$50,000-$100,000",
                Var1 == 3 ~ ">$100,000",
                TRUE ~ NA
            ),
            Freq = paste0(Freq, " (", signif(100 * Freq / nrow(data), 3), "%)")
        ) |>
        dplyr::rename("label" = "Var1", "value" = "Freq")
    income_df <- rbind(
        data.frame("label" = "*Income*", value = ""),
        income_df
    )
    # 5. Race 
    race_names <- names(table(df$"race"))
    race_counts <- as.numeric(table(df$"race"))
    race_pcts <- race_counts / nrow(df) * 100
    race_df <- lapply(
        1:length(race_pcts),
        function(x) {
            data.frame(
                label = race_names[x],
                value = paste0(race_counts[x], " (", signif(race_pcts[x], 3), "%)")
            )
        }
    ) |> do.call(what = rbind)
    race_df <- rbind(
        data.frame("label" = "*Race*", value = ""),
        race_df
    )
    return(
        list(
            sex_df,
            age_df,
            income_df,
            race_df
        ) |>
        do.call(what = rbind)
    )
}
